title: urban-functional-maps: open mobility data for functional-area maps
description:
Reproducible pipeline, paper and slides on what open mobility sources leave out (origin-destination pairs, trip purpose, time of day) and on how much of a functional-area map is produced by scale, contiguity and algorithm.

Sources: census commuting matrices of England and Wales (2011, 2021), Serbian census bands (2022), Dutch register pairs (2014), the Japanese nationwide people-flow panel (2019 to 2021), OpenStreetMap public GPS traces.

Methods: a closed form for the permutation null of partition self-containment; a null of random contiguous partitions; a spatial error matrix counted in employed residents, with intersection over union, omission and commission against the official Travel to Work Areas; clusterability tests for temporal signatures.

Prepared for FOSS4G 2026, Hiroshima.
notes: Code: MIT. Text, figures and slides: CC BY 4.0. Input data are not part of the archive; they keep the licence of their publisher and are listed with address and checksum in data/manifest.yaml.
